summaries.source: sections/sec-000-非洲区域主任关于区域关键性-业务和管理改革问题战略和进展的报告.md

narrative.text: Reports, in Chinese, the WHO African Regional Director's account of the region's 1994 work amid economic recession, political unrest and humanitarian emergencies. It describes the 44th session of the Regional Committee in Brazzaville, which adopted the 1996–1997 programme budget, reflected on the Rwanda crisis, welcomed Eritrea and the return of South Africa, and nominated Dr Ibrahim Samba as Regional Director. It then covers management of the regional programme, including decentralised teams set up during insecurity in Congo, and support to national health services such as medical training reform and solar-powered equipment. The report ends with programme coordination and information work and continued external cooperation with UN agencies, the World Bank, the OAU and NGOs; the OCR contains some scattered character errors, for example in years.

以中文报告世界卫生组织非洲区域主任关于该区域1994年工作的陈述，当时正值经济萧条、社会政治动乱和人道主义紧急情况。报告介绍在布拉柴维尔举行的区域委员会第四十四届会议：会议通过了1996–1997年规划预算，反思了卢旺达危机，欢迎厄立特里亚加入和南非回归，并提名Ibrahim Samba博士为区域主任。随后涉及区域规划的管理，包括在刚果不安全期间设立的分散工作小组，以及对国家卫生服务的支持，如医学培训改革和太阳能设备。报告最后介绍规划协调与信息工作，以及与联合国各机构、世界银行、非洲统一组织和非政府组织的持续外部合作；文字识别结果中有一些零星的字符错误，例如年份。

The Chinese-language front page of WHO Executive Board document EB95/8 (October 1994), in which the Director-General transmits the African Regional Director's report on strategies and progress in key operational and management reform.
世界卫生组织执行委员会文件EB95/8（1994年10月）的中文首页，总干事在文件中转交非洲区域主任关于主要业务和管理改革问题战略和进展的报告。
